##### Project general facts

PGD Aparthotel is a contemporary residential development located in Canggu, Bali, one of the world’s most sought-after destinations, just 700 meters from Berawa Beach. The complex consists of 85 fully furnished units, including 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to maximize space and functionality. The project follows a hotel-style concept, offering a seamless blend of residential comfort and hospitality standards, making it ideal for both personal use and rental income.

Residents will benefit from a wide range of amenities designed for comfort, relax and productivity. The development includes swimming pools for adults and children, rooftop gym facilities, coworking spaces, a restaurant with lounge areas, and dedicated parking for cars and bikes. With additional features such as relaxation zones and premium services, the project creates a vibrant lifestyle environment while offering strong investment potential.

Units are featuring modern layouts, high-quality finishes, and full equipment with appliances and stylish furniture. The project reflects a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and global standards. Designed in collaboration with international architects, the development combines modern architecture with eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient solutions, creating a comfortable and investment-attractive environment.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Canggu is one of the most vibrant and sought-after areas on the southwest coast of Bali, known for its unique blend of tropical charm and modern lifestyle. Once a quiet coastal village, it has transformed into a global hotspot that attracts tourists, expats, and investors from around the world. With its iconic black-sand beaches, scenic rice fields, and relaxed atmosphere, Canggu offers a perfect balance between natural beauty and contemporary living.

Within Canggu, Berawa stands out as one of the most prestigious and fast-growing neighborhoods. Centered around Berawa Beach, this area is known for its upscale vibe, beachfront lifestyle, and strong community appeal. The area is renowned for its dynamic lifestyle scene as well as a wide variety of trendy cafes, restaurants, fitness studios, and boutique shops. Canggu has become a hub for digital nomads and creatives, supported by numerous coworking spaces and a strong international community. This well-developed infrastructure makes it one of the most convenient and desirable places to live on the island.

In addition to its lifestyle appeal, Canggu offers strong investment potential driven by year-round tourist demand and a thriving short-term rental market. Its proximity to key attractions such as Berawa Beach further enhances its value, while continuous development contributes to long-term property appreciation. Combining a relaxed coastal atmosphere with high growth potential, Canggu remains one of Bali’s top locations for both living and investment.
